verdict.hairGoodText: Haircut and care work at full strength
verdict.calmText: Better not to start drastic changes — care and nails are fine
verdict.bodyGainsText: The waxing moon absorbs — time for nourishing food and vitamins
verdict.bodyReleasesText: The waning moon flushes out — good for fasting and light food

cut.name: Haircut
cut.about: Hair cut on a waxing moon grows back faster and thicker. On a waning moon a haircut keeps its shape longer — choose by goal: volume or a clean outline.

color.name: Coloring
color.about: Pigment sets better while the moon is waxing. On days around the new moon color washes out faster, and bleaching gives an unpredictable shade.

skin.name: Care & masks
skin.about: Skin absorbs more actively on a waxing moon — masks and serums work at full strength. On a waning moon cleansing and peels are more effective.

cosm.name: Cosmetologist
cosm.about: Injections and device treatments are best planned for a waning moon: swelling goes down faster, bruises fade sooner.

epil.name: Hair removal
epil.about: On a waning moon hair grows back slower and the result lasts longer. A waxing moon is the worst time for hair removal.

mass.name: Massage
mass.about: Lymphatic drainage and deep bodywork are more effective on a waning moon: the body releases excess fluid more easily.

bath.name: Bath & sauna
bath.about: A waning moon boosts elimination — the bath works as a detox. Around the full moon the heart may react strongly.

nails.name: Manicure & pedicure
nails.about: Nails grow faster on a waxing moon. A waning moon is for strengthening and treatment, not extensions.

calendar.eatWhyWaxing: The waxing moon boosts absorption: the body takes more from food — both the good and the excess.
calendar.eatWhyWaning: The waning moon works on release: the body parts with fluid and heavy food more easily.
calendar.waterWaxingHint: More than usual — there is puffiness
calendar.dietStartSub: After the full moon — weight comes off easier
